evidence.explanation: 8-state DFA. States: q0 = initial; q_fa/q_fb = read first char a/b; q_yes = prefix was palindromic (aa or bb), accept sink; q_xa = no prefix palindrome, last char 'a' (prev different); q_aa = last two chars 'aa' (accept); q_xb = no prefix palindrome, last char 'b' (prev different); q_bb = last two chars 'bb' (accept). The DFA tracks whether the word started with aa/bb (immediate accept) and otherwise tracks last two chars to detect aa/bb suffix.
